description: Add production-readiness middleware and infrastructure: rate limiting (slowapi), structured JSON logging with request/response timing, security headers middleware, global exception handler with graceful degradation, and monitoring/metrics endpoint.
steps: Add slowapi and python-json-logger to ai_backend/requirements.txt

Create ai_backend/app/middleware/logging.py - Implement structured JSON logging middleware that logs each request method, path, status code, and response time in milliseconds. Use Python's standard logging module with a JSON formatter.

Create ai_backend/app/middleware/security.py - Add security headers middleware that adds X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-XSS-Protection: 1; mode=block, Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self' to every response.

Create ai_backend/app/middleware/rate_limiter.py - Implement rate limiting using slowapi with limits: 30/minute for /api/predict, /api/explain, /api/what-if, /api/predict/batch; 10/minute for /api/advisor; 60/minute for other endpoints. Include a custom rate limit exceeded handler that returns JSON error.

Create ai_backend/app/middleware/error_handler.py - Implement a global exception handler that catches all unhandled exceptions and returns a consistent JSON error response {success: false, error: str, detail: str, timestamp: str}. If ML model fails during prediction, return a fallback deterministic prediction instead of 500.

Create ai_backend/app/middleware/metrics.py - Implement an in-memory metrics collector that tracks: total_predictions, total_requests, avg_response_time_ms, model_version, uptime_seconds, popular_programs (top 5 by request count), endpoint_stats (hits per endpoint).
Add GET /api/metrics endpoint in ai_backend/app/main.py that returns the collected metrics as JSON.

Wire all middleware into ai_backend/app/main.py in the correct order: security headers first, then logging, then rate limiting. Update the startup event to initialize metrics. Keep existing CORS middleware.

Add OpenAPI metadata enhancements to ai_backend/app/main.py: add tags_metadata list with descriptions for each tag group (Prediction, Recommendation, Advisor, Monitoring, Explainability), add contact/license info to FastAPI constructor, add response_model and openapi_extra examples to existing endpoints.
Update ai_backend/Dockerfile to install new dependencies from updated requirements.txt
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/metrics returns JSON with total_predictions, avg_response_time_ms, model_version, uptime_seconds fields
Every response includes X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, X-XSS-Protection, Content-Security-Policy headers
Rate limiting returns 429 status with JSON error body when limit exceeded
Unhandled exceptions return consistent JSON error format with 500 status
Structured log output includes request method, path, status_code, response_time_ms fields
OpenAPI docs at /docs show professional tags, descriptions, and examples
verification: All tests pass including new tests for metrics, security headers, error handling
